transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net TV support, my name is Oscar. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Oscar, my name is Fiona MacLeod. My S-Net TV voice remote control stopped working after the automated firmware update last night, and the microphone button does absolutely nothing when I try to search for programmes!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Fiona. I can look into your TV box pairing and voice remote telemetry. Before we inspect your remote profile, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 18 Rosemount Viaduct, Aberdeen, AB25 1NT, and my security PIN is 4092. My TV box model is the S-Net 4K Hub Box with serial number SN-88201.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Fiona, that confirms your account details. What happens on the TV screen when you press the microphone button on the remote?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Nothing happens at all! No microphone listening icon appears, and speech search does not activate. But the regular channel up and down buttons work because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you see the small LED light at the top of the remote when you press the voice button in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It flashes a slow orange light twice and then turns off so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a couple of minutes while I check the remote firmware patch status on our digital television gateway across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Fiona. The gateway logs indicate firmware update 3.14 was applied overnight, which de-coupled the Bluetooth Low Energy voice channel into fallback infrared mode to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am severely arthritic in both my hands and I rely entirely on voice search commands to navigate channels and find my recorded programmes! Having to physically press tiny plastic buttons repeatedly causes me severe physical joint pain! I am in tears with frustration right now so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Firmware version 3.14 required all peripheral voice accessories to re-handshake encrypted Bluetooth security tokens in accordance with our standard telecommunications network diagnostic procedures.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I do not care about security tokens, Oscar! Tell me how to get the microphone working so I can use my TV without hurting my hands since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: To restore voice functionality, the remote must be switched out of infrared fallback mode back into Bluetooth LE mode across all your connected household devices including laptops, mobile phones, and streaming hardware.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How do I do that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You must perform a simultaneous two-button handshake sequence while pointing the remote at the TV box to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Which buttons do I need to press?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously voice search requires bidirectional Bluetooth bandwidth rather than unidirectional infrared pulses to ensure your S-Net service operates reliably without unexpected dropped packets or connection faults.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I understand that, please just tell me the buttons so I really appreciate you taking the time to look into these technical details with me today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press and hold the 'Voice' button and the 'OK' button together simultaneously for five seconds so that your account records and provisioning parameters remain completely up to date.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding Voice and OK together... One, two, three, four, five... Oscar, my fingers are swollen and throbbing with agony trying to hold these stiff buttons down! Why do you make technology so painful for disabled customers?! The light is flashing rapid blue since we depend heavily on this service for remote working and family communications every day.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now release both buttons. The TV screen should display a pairing prompt to maintain optimal throughput and low latency across the regional distribution network.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes! A box popped up saying 'Voice Remote Paired Successfully - Battery 90%' because having a reliable home broadband connection is absolutely essential for our daily household work.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press and hold the voice button, speak 'BBC One', and release the button.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding button... 'BBC One'... Releasing button... Yes! A blue listening bar appeared and BBC One immediately tuned in!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Splendid! Let us try another voice command to search recorded shows.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Holding voice button... 'Open Recordings'... Yes! It opened my recorded series list instantly without pressing any arrow keys!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was that TV box model again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you during verification, it is the S-Net 4K Hub Box.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms full Bluetooth Low Energy voice profile re-establishment with your 4K Hub Box.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank goodness. I can navigate my television comfortably again without pain in my hands.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If your remote ever loses Bluetooth connection in the future, holding Voice and OK together for five seconds will re-bind the channel immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I have written that down on my TV guide notepad.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We have re-established the Bluetooth voice connection, confirmed voice channel switching, and verified recorded shows search.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Everything is working smoothly now. Thank you Oscar.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other technical matter regarding your TV box or remote I can assist you with today, Fiona?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your 4K Hub Box will retain the paired Bluetooth device profile through future automatic software updates.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me peace of mind that it will not unpair again next week.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Bluetooth remote provides thirty feet of wireless range without requiring line of sight.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very convenient from my armchair across the living room.
